findings.description: Man drags the straight razor across non-shaving areas including the center forehead and directly over the eyelid/eyebrow (00:02-00:04 and again 00:09). No shaving cream, no beard hair in that region, and the blade contacts eyelid skin at a perpendicular angle. This is not a plausible shaving technique and depicts an unsafe, implausible grooming action that would need correction before publication.

Throughout 00:00-00:09 the razor repeatedly strokes chin, cheek, nose and forehead with audible scraping but produces no visible effect: no shaving cream/lather present at any time, no hair removal, no skin displacement, no residue on blade. Contact leaves no trace, indicating a simulated action without expected material consequences.
